expansion: Gems, precious stones and jewelry from Latin America
tagline: From Raw Beauty to Timeless Value — from raw beauty to value that lasts
description: ROUGH.LAT is an editorial magazine about raw gems, precious stones, jewelry, artisanal carving and responsible luxury, designed for readers in Latin America: clear guides, verifiable sources and zero investment promises.
author: ROUGH.LAT Editorial

gemas-en-bruto.name: Gems in the rough
gemas-en-bruto.description: How gems are born in the rock, how they are recognized without cutting and what a crystal reveals before passing through the lapidary wheel.

piedras-preciosas.name: gemstones
piedras-preciosas.description: Quality, treatments, synthetics, imitations and laboratory reports: what you need to know before trusting a stone.

joyeria-y-diseno.name: Jewelry and design
joyeria-y-diseno.description: Metals, settings, engagement rings, custom design and care of the jewelry so that it lasts for generations.

arte-tallado-y-artesania.name: Carving and crafts
arte-tallado-y-artesania.description: The lapidary wheel, the types of carving, the traditional workshops and the path from the rough stone to the finished jewel.

lujo-y-estilo-de-vida.name: Luxury and lifestyle
lujo-y-estilo-de-vida.description: How to wear, gift and collect jewelry judiciously, and how to buy luxury responsibly.
